transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, yeah… I guess the big thing is my eating’s been really off. Like, I’ll go into a shift and realize I’ve only had coffee and maybe a granola bar all day, which is stupid because I work around people all day and I know better. The vending machine at work has these terrible ones, the chewy kind, not even the good crunchy ones—anyway.

And my scrubs are starting to hang on me, like loose in the waist, and I’m not trying to lose weight or anything. That’s mostly why I came in.
Have you noticed a decrease in your appetite or interest in food recently?

Yeah, definitely. I mean, it’s not like I’m dieting or anything—I just don’t really feel like eating, or I forget until I’m already at work and running around. Some days it’s just coffee and maybe a granola bar before my shift, and then I notice my scrubs are loose, like hanging off more at the waist.

It’s weird because I’m around food smells and break rooms and people talking about lunch all day, but I still just… don’t get around to it.
Have you noticed any significant weight loss recently, even without trying to lose weight?

Yeah… I mean, I haven’t been trying to lose weight at all, but my scrubs have started hanging loose, especially around the waist. That’s kind of what made me notice it.

It’s probably because some days I barely eat before work—like coffee and maybe a granola bar, and then the shift gets busy and I just keep moving. The granola bars at work are awful too, the soft chewy ones that stick in your teeth, so half the time I don’t even want those. But yeah, the loose scrubs thing is what got my attention.
Have you lost more than 10% of your body weight recently without trying?

I don’t know the exact percent, honestly. I haven’t been weighing myself like that. I just noticed my scrubs are hanging loose at the waist, and I’m not trying to lose weight.

It’s probably because my eating’s been so off—some days before a shift it’s just coffee and maybe a granola bar, and then I get moving and forget. But more than 10%… I can’t really say for sure.
Can you estimate how much weight you’ve lost recently, if any, without trying to lose weight?

I can’t give you a clean number, honestly. I haven’t stepped on a scale much. But it’s enough that I noticed my scrubs hanging loose, especially at the waist, and that usually doesn’t happen unless something’s changed.

And I’m not trying to lose weight. My eating’s just gotten really off—like some days I get coffee down, maybe a granola bar before my shift, and then I’m running around and don’t really eat. It kind of sneaks up on you at work because everybody’s busy, and then suddenly your pants don’t fit right.
Have you noticed that your weight loss is more than 10% of your usual body weight, even without trying to lose weight?

I don’t know if it’s more than 10%, honestly. I haven’t been tracking it like that.

What I do know is my eating’s gotten pretty messed up—some days I barely get coffee and a granola bar down before a shift, and then the whole day just kind of runs away from me. And my scrubs have been hanging loose, which… you notice that, you know? Especially at work when you’re pulling at them all day. But I’m not trying to lose weight.
